default_parity: All four control seeds match archived pre-hook rows exactly.
decision: Not adopted. The focused diagnostic replaces over 98% of Curse/Destiny Bond and improves side 1 first-action loss, but side 0 worsens and remaining cells are biased. This is not a matched-time strength result.
scope: One known-type Bond fixture, four paired seeds. Warm ordinary searches are identical; only fresh root probes may stop at the sampled nonterminal first child. Returned values have certified width at most 0.005 for that concrete state, including already expanded children. Unresolved values use the original continuation search. Additional solver work is charged and reported; this is not a matched-time strength comparison, a certificate for a hidden-information strategy, or a production change. The focused ablation, when enabled, spends its entire solver budget on Curse/Destiny Bond, the cell identified by the previously archived terminal traces; it is a fixture-specific diagnostic.
